name: The Baldwin Insurance Group, Inc.

corporate_actions.event: Completed CAC Group and two other acquisitions (balance sheet: total assets $3.9bn -> $5.9bn, debt $1.76bn -> $2.46bn in 1Q26)

Signed merger agreement to be taken private by Sequence Holdings and DFO Management (Michael Dell family office) at $32.50 cash per Class A share (~$7.7bn EV); expected close Q1-2027; requires majority vote of Class A + B

geography.fx_notes: 'Insurance distribution company operating in the United States' (PitchBook) - treated as ~100% US (INFERENCE from description; no foreign segment).

acquisitions.notes: CAC Group + 2 others closed Jan-2026; three deals grew revenue 16% y/y in Q3 (secondary)

ownership.controlling_holders: Founders/management hold Class B (Up-C); take-private by Sequence Holdings/DFO
ownership.board_independence: Special committee ran sale process (25 investors contacted, 6 bids)
ownership.related_party: Management/founder participation in buyer group not confirmed in sources used

evidence: Commission-based renewing revenue; Mainstreet personal lines (S1)
Personal lines and embedded homebuilder channel (S1)
I1.rationale: Personal lines exposed to digital/embedded distribution.

evidence: Net loss -$81.6m Q3-26 vs adj EBITDA +$106.9m (S4)

sector_specific.organic_ex_rate_note: Not analysed in depth: pending take-private (G6 = A).

gates.notes: G6 = A: agreed take-private at $32.50 cash (signed 14-Sep-2026, close expected Q1-2027) - transaction-dominated, delisting. G1 = A: gross debt/adj EBITDA ~6.4x (>5.0x) with no standalone deleveraging path (buyer to refinance). G4 = B: persistent GAAP losses make FCF/NI not meaningful. Screened at reduced depth after G6 finding.

bull_points: Deal price $32.50 offers 87.5% premium to unaffected price; no financing condition.
bear_points: Excluded: pending take-private - no long-term listed equity exposure available.
Standalone: leverage ~6x and persistent GAAP losses.
thesis_breakers: Merger agreement terminated (would require full re-underwriting).
